name: Inflict Pain
text:
**Inflict Pain**

**School** enchantment [mind-affecting, pain]; **Level** antipaladin 2, arcanist 3, inquisitor 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer 3, spiritualist 2, witch 3, wizard 3
**Casting Time** 1 standard action
**Components** V, S
**Range** close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
**Target** one creature
**Duration** 1 round/level
**Saving Throw** Will partial, see text; **Spell Resistance** yes

You telepathically wrack the target’s mind and body with agonizing pain that imposes a –4 penalty on attack rolls, skill checks, and ability checks. A successful Will save reduces the duration to 1 round.
